newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere falls on A share oversupply.
newsitem.headline: Solidere falls on A share oversupply.

text.p: Solidere shares fell on higher turnover on Wednesday. A shares fell to $113 from $114 and B shares fell slightly to $117.1250 from $117.625.
Turnover rose to 11,162 shares from 8,273 and value was $1,282,154.375 from $955,611.50.
Brokers said an oversupply of A shares was pulling Solidere prices down.
Also traded on the Beirut Stock Exchange were 10,000 shares of industrial piping manufacturer Eternit at $1.50, down 20 percent from $1.875 on October 11 when 1,000 shares were traded.
The declines dragged down both share indexes with the LISPI stock index falling 3.32 percent to 81.77 and the BLOM stock index falling 0.67 percent to 977.77.
Brokers had no immediate explanation for the drop in Eternit prices but said it was probably a consequence of a large amount of trading in the shares taking place outside the Beirut Stock Exchange.
There was no trade in the three other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, and Uniceramic.
